idea-plugin.name: RobOS IDE Review Bridge & Autonomous Agent Harness
idea-plugin.description:
RobOS IDE Review Bridge & Autonomous Agent Harness

Integrates JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA with the RobOS AI-First SDLC Platform and Autonomous Agent Governance Harness.

  • Port 63343 IPC Server: High-speed bi-directional JSON HTTP IPC server.
  • Secret-Managed Run Configurations: Zero-plaintext secret injection resolving UNIX pass GPG credentials at runtime.
  • Interactive Breakpoint Debugger: Webhook event notifications on breakpoint suspension with instant paused thread variables and stack frame inspection.
  • Ephemeral Multi-Project Workspaces: Dynamic multi-repo project workspace orchestration with automated session lifecycle destruction.
  • Native PR Review Tool Window: JetBrains tool window displaying active RobOS task, sprint status, and AI proposed diagnostic plans.
